summary: Phase A + B — Universal Action-Item Store. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases PASS (CRUD + enum validation on source_module/recurrence_type/priority/status, list filters source_module/source_id/source_subref/priority/status/not_ported, partial update + done→100%-auto, soft-cancel DELETE, port-to-ctt with downstream ctt_tasks row + ACTION_ITEM source link, port-to-lifestyle with one_time→recurring auto-upgrade, 409 on double-port, unport clears link but preserves downstream CTT/Lifestyle doc, import-from-mpps imports 3 of 4 raw items (skips empty title) and is idempotent on re-call, stats/summary returns total/by_status/by_source/by_ported). Frontend: Home dashboard correctly shows the new teal 'Action Center' banner and NO LONGER renders the duplicate 'My Dezider - 10 Steps' static preview nor the 'Coming Soon → Conflict Breaker' SOON card (only one Conflict Breaker entry routes to /tools/conflict-breaker). /tools/action-center page loads, stat counters reflect the universal store (Total=2, Done=0, In CTT=1, LifeStyle=1), STATUS/SOURCE/TRACKING chip filters all rendered and clickable, both pre-existing items (Email vendor→PROS_CONS·In CTT, Morning workout→MANUAL·In LifeStyle) render with proper ported_to pills. ActionItemEditor.tsx is wired into both pros-cons-wizard.tsx (after ModuleStoreActions, line 1968) and swot.tsx (line 380); Step9 has the 'Push to Action Center · CTT / LifeStyle' button calling /api/action-items/import-from-mpps and routing to /tools/action-center. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (pre-existing, flagged in iterations 13-16).

action_items: Phase A + B verified end-to-end — no fixes required for the new code.
OPTIONAL (pre-SDK-54 migration): Replace expo-av usage with expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video). Flagged in iterations 13-16 as well.

OPTIONAL: Add testID props to /tools/action-center key elements (stat-total, chip-status-pending, port-ctt-btn, etc.) and to ActionItemEditor (add-btn, save-btn) for more deterministic future automation — currently selectors fall back to text matching.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/action_items.py (424 lines) is well within the 700-line budget and has a clear sectioned layout (Constants → CRUD → Porting → Bulk → Stats).
_normalise() strictly validates all enums and clamps progress_pct to [0,100]; status='done' auto-sets progress to 100 — verified.
Port endpoints idempotency: 2nd call returns 409 with the existing target embedded in the detail — verified for both CTT and Lifestyle.
import-from-mpps idempotency key (user_id + source_module + source_id + title + by_when + who) is correct and produces 0-import on rerun — verified.
_id is excluded everywhere (find() projections + explicit doc.pop) — no ObjectId leakage.
Source-id/sub-ref filters work; the user_id scoping is applied to every list/get/update/delete/port endpoint.
ActionItemEditor.tsx uses api util with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no hardcoded URLs); /tools/action-center.tsx uses URLSearchParams correctly for filter querying.
Step9.tsx Push-to-Action-Center button correctly POSTs and on success offers a navigation prompt to /tools/action-center.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home dashboard cleanup verified; /tools/action-center renders, stats correct, filters present, ported items visible)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates ~15 TEST_* action_items + 1 TEST_MPPS_* decision; all are deleted in module-scope teardown via direct mongo cleanup (action_items, ctt_tasks, lifestyle_routines, decisions). 2 main-agent-seeded items (Email vendor, Morning workout from LAUNCH50 coupon test) remain — they were preserved, not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_action_items.py is regression-ready against admin@test.com. It depends on direct mongo cleanup, so MONGO_URL + DB_NAME env vars must point to the same DB the backend is using (defaults: mongodb://localhost:27017 / test_database). The 'Morning workout' and 'Email vendor' rows that show up in /tools/action-center belong to user_df675539a77a from prior LAUNCH50 coupon test — feel free to delete them via /api/action-items/{id} (soft-cancel) if you need a clean slate. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct env var (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL).
